hooks.command: ts=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d-%H%M'); checkpoint=".claude/checkpoint-$ts.md"; { echo "# Checkpoint — $(date '+%Y-%m-%d, %Hh%M')"; echo ""; echo "> Auto-generated before compaction. Resume with this file."; echo ""; echo "## Recent commits (last 5)"; echo ""; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "(no git history)"; echo ""; echo "## Current state"; echo ""; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo "(no changes)"; echo ""; echo "## Files in .claude/"; echo ""; ls -1 .claude/*.md 2>/dev/null | tail -5 || echo "(none)"; echo ""; echo "## Next steps"; echo ""; echo "- Review blockers/errors above"; echo "- Continue from last commit's goal"; echo "- Check .claude/terminology-refactor-plan.md for pending tasks"; } > "$checkpoint"; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Checkpoint created: $checkpoint\"}"; cat "$checkpoint" >&2
